title: resolution of the text
description:
Enhance the entire image to professional, high-resolution quality. Make all product photos look sharp, clean, natural, and realistic without changing the original layout, colors, proportions, or design.

Improve the image clarity, lighting, reflections, shadows, edges, and overall details. Remove blur, noise, pixelation, blemishes, rough edges, and compression artifacts. Keep the products smooth, polished, and naturally integrated into the layout.

Make all text, numbers, icons, labels, measurement lines, and specifications crisp, properly aligned, and easy to read. Ensure the typography looks natural and professionally printed—not artificial, distorted, stretched, misspelled, or blurry.

Preserve the exact wording, font style, text placement, product appearance, background, and composition. Do not add, remove, or replace any information. Deliver a clean, balanced, realistic, high-quality image that is ready for posting on an e-commerce listing.
